subject: Input-output section
notes: Format: 'INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION. [ file-control-paragraph ] [ i-o-control-paragraph ]' (cite.py --check 12.4.2 "INPUT-OUTPUT" -> OK §12.4.2 General format). Grammar `inputOutputSection : INPUT_OUTPUT SECTION DOT fileControlParagraph? ioControlParagraph?` is the format verbatim: both words required, period required, both paragraphs optional, FILE-CONTROL before I-O-CONTROL. environmentDivision places it after configurationSection? (the §12.2 order). Bound by DataBinder.BindFileControl (env.inputOutputSection()?.fileControlParagraph()) and BindIoControl. Probes (pinned cobol.exe, E:/Temp/claude/E--COBOL/a700c052-f9e4-4942-84ff-a13c7505d6ec/scratchpad/adj-d1/out/probe/iosec): p1 both paragraphs -> runs 'OK' at 2023; p2 empty INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION. -> runs 'EMPTY' at 2023 and at --std 85; p3 I-O-CONTROL before FILE-CONTROL -> COBOL0001 unexpected 'FILE-CONTROL', exit 65 (correct: the format orders them). Edition note: the 2023 spec carries no edition difference for this format, so the uniform acceptance is what the spec derives; whether COBOL-85 required FILE-CONTROL inside the section is not stated in ISO_COBOL.md and is not a basis for a verdict here. test-ref left empty: goldens exercise the both-paragraph shape (e.g. conformance:cases/14.9.32-RELEASE/l1_release_same_record_area) but none pins the optional-paragraph arms (empty section / I-O-CONTROL only) or the ordering refusal.
